name: io.github.vihatteam/omicall-mcp
description: MCP server for OmiCall/OmiCRM: call center, tickets, contacts, omnichannel chat, AI bots, OmiFlow

environmentVariables.name: OMICALL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OmiCall API key (alternative to email/password auth)

environmentVariables.name: OMICALL_TENANT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Tenant ID to auto-select when the account has multiple tenants

environmentVariables.name: OMICALL_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool groups to load (callcenter, ticket, multichannel, contact, agent, webhook, autocall, ai, aiconfig, omiflow). Default: all

environmentVariables.name: OMICALL_ENV
environmentVariables.description: Environment. Only "stg" exists (OmiCall live environment); other values fall back to stg
